mapper.select: WITH monthly_summary AS ( -- 计算每个学生每月的课程数（排除临时课程） SELECT vLsn.stu_id, vLsn.stu_name, vLsn.subject_id, vLsn.subject_name, vLsn.lsn_month, SUM(vLsn.lsn_count) AS monthly_count FROM v_info_lesson_fee_connect_lsn_and_extraToScheDataCorrect vLsn WHERE vLsn.lesson_type = 1 -- 按月交费的学生 AND vLsn.lsn_month BETWEEN CONCAT(#{year}, '-01') AND CONCAT(#{year}, '-12') -- 指定年度 AND vLsn.lesson_id NOT LIKE 'kn-lsn-tmp-%' -- 排除临时课程(统计年度43节课不能把虚课算进去，这是AI帮我考虑的，真棒👍) GROUP BY vLsn.stu_id, vLsn.stu_name, vLsn.subject_id, vLsn.subject_name, vLsn.lsn_month ), cumulative_summary AS ( -- 计算累计课程数，找出达到43节课的月份 SELECT stu_id, stu_name, subject_id, subject_name, lsn_month, monthly_count, SUM(monthly_count) OVER ( PARTITION BY stu_id, subject_id ORDER BY lsn_month ) AS cumulative_count FROM monthly_summary ) SELECT cs.stu_id AS stuId, cs.stu_name AS stuName, cs.subject_id AS subjectId, cs.subject_name AS subjectName, MAX(cs.cumulative_count) AS cumulativeCount, CAST(SUBSTRING(MIN(CASE WHEN cs.cumulative_count >= 43 THEN cs.lsn_month END), 6, 2) AS UNSIGNED) AS monthsCompleted, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT MONTH(tmp.schedual_date)) FROM t_info_lesson_tmp tmp WHERE tmp.stu_id = cs.stu_id AND tmp.subject_id = cs.subject_id AND YEAR(tmp.schedual_date) = #{year} ) AS generatedMonths FROM cumulative_summary cs WHERE cs.cumulative_count >= 43 -- 只选择达到43节课的记录 GROUP BY cs.stu_id, cs.stu_name, cs.subject_id, cs.subject_name ORDER BY cs.stu_name, cs.subject_id

SELECT tmp.lsn_tmp_id AS lsnTmpId, tmp.stu_id AS stuId, tmp.subject_id AS subjectId, tmp.schedual_date AS schedualDate, fee.lsn_fee_id AS lsnFeeId, fee.lsn_fee AS lsnFee, fee.own_flg AS ownFlg FROM t_info_lesson_tmp tmp INNER JOIN t_info_lesson_fee fee ON tmp.lsn_tmp_id = fee.lesson_id WHERE tmp.stu_id = #{stuId} AND tmp.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND YEAR(tmp.schedual_date) = #{year} ORDER BY tmp.schedual_date
